name: Privileged Access Management
description: Privileged access management (PAM) — also called a credential vault, secrets/privileged-session management, just-in-time access, CyberArk/HashiCorp Vault, or break-glass control — brokers, vaults, and time-bounds administrative credentials to constrain the blast radius of privileged-account abuse. The place to look for PAM, credential vaulting, just-in-time admin access, privileged session brokering, or securing high-privilege accounts.
